R339.note: Overflow-safe bounds check (headerLen > UINT32_MAX - payloadLen) before allocation correctly closes the wraparound; rejection path (nullptr) is disclosed and only rejects genuinely malicious/invalid inputs.

R340.note: os.Lstat + IsRegular correctly rejects symlinks before the follow-symlink read, matching the stated contract exactly (regular files still read, symlinks rejected).

R341.note: Adds the missing per-event role check mirroring the sibling handler's early-return pattern; only non-admin misuse is now rejected, which is the intended authorization boundary.

R342.note: Denylist of literal keywords (require/eval/Function/process/global) does not close vm.runInNewContext escapes: Node's own docs state vm provides no security boundary against untrusted code, and trivial bypasses exist (bracket notation, string concatenation, this.constructor.constructor, unicode escapes) that never spell the banned tokens; the added regex checks also newly reject any script containing those words, a stated but avoidable restriction.

R343.note: Adds requireRole('admin') matching every sibling admin route; restores intended authorization boundary with no incidental change.

R344.note: json_encode with JSON_HEX_* flags is the correct JS-string-literal encoding for this sink; decoded value and displayed text are unchanged for legitimate input.

R345.note: Per-category method allowlist closes arbitrary-method invocation while keeping the one legitimate method (send) callable; no new restriction on legitimate traffic.

R346.note: Adds attribute-context escaping (&, ", <, >) specifically for the double-quoted title attribute while leaving the DOMPurify-sanitized body untouched, matching the stated contract for both sinks.

R347.note: Flips setSecure(false) to setSecure(true) and updates the paired status message for consistency, a disclosed and directly-tied change, not an unrelated behavior change.

R348.note: Allowlist of the four columns actually in the SELECT list preserves bound account_id/status params and the default created_at sort, matching the stated contract.

R349.note: String-based ObjectInputFilter with proper package-boundary pattern (com.example.report.*) closes the sibling-package prefix bypass (com.example.report_evil...) that the original startsWith() check allowed, and adds java.lang/java.util needed for legitimate report deserialization.

R350.note: Replaces Math.random() with SecureRandom producing 16 bytes / 128 bits, base64url-encoded; token format changes but nothing in the case depends on the prior decimal-digit format.
